model.role_model: two-role: attacker SUT + PINNED victim baseline (separate ids)

run_limitations: Sample size is a probe, not a powered estimate; the interval is wide.
Victim is the PINNED baseline (palmfuture/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GPTQ-Int4); G1 is backed separately by evidence/pinned-baseline-g1.json.
The action-plan victim emits its whole plan at once and never sees intermediate tool results (a floor-probe abstraction; a gate-grade ceiling run would use the true multi-turn loop).
The victim runs on the local box, whose model build is run-to-run nondeterministic, so each twin is a single sample; results are directional only.
User-selected stand-in (2026-10-09) for Kimi K3, which exists on AWS Bedrock but has a 0 token quota on this account; moonshotai.kimi-k2.5 is the newest Kimi model available.
